# Canonical conventional-commit types for this repository.
#
# Two things must agree with this list:
#
#   1. The PR title gate, .github/workflows/conventional-commits.yml, which
#      carries a copy of it inside a regex (it runs on pull_request_target and
#      so must not read repository files).
#   2. release-please, which decides what produces a changelog entry and a
#      version bump.
#
# scripts/check-commit-types.ts fails if the regex drifts from this list, and
# the Commit Types workflow runs it on every change to either file.
#
# These are release-please's default changelog sections, because
# release-please-config.json declares none and inherits them. A type outside
# this list is ignored by release-please: the commit lands, no changelog entry
# appears and no version bump happens. That is why the gate rejects them
# rather than letting them through.
#
# One type per line. Blank lines and comments are ignored.

build
chore
ci
docs
feat
fix
perf
refactor
revert
style
test
